pipeline.description: lrpt (Meteor-M LRPT, default) or apt (NOAA APT: for recordings only, no NOAA satellite transmits it any more).

symbol_rate.description: LRPT symbol rate: 72k (Meteor-M N2-3 and N2-4, default) or 80k.

satellite.description: Name to store with a pass when SatDump cannot tell the satellite.

threshold_db.description: dB over the noise floor that count as a signal (0.5 to 30, default 3).

min_seconds.description: Shortest recording that is decoded (3 to 900, default 60).

max_minutes.description: Longest recording; a pass is cut there (2 to 40, default 20).

arm_seconds.description: How long the signal must stay up before a pass starts (1 to 60, default 5).

hang_seconds.description: How long it must stay down before the pass is over (1 to 300, default 30).
